content:
It's a personal preference. For most people, i'd recommend using the stable branch. Beta versions by their nature may contain bugs that get fixed ahead of general release.

You can use the beta and return to the stable branch once version 24 reaches the app stores. App settings and accounts can be imported directly from the beta into the stable version.

In fact, if you wanted, you could do this now with the current stable version.

  1. Scan your accounts into the beta version and complete any sign-in steps.
  2. Open the stable version
  3. Select import K-9 settings
  4. Select import from app
  5. Select Thunderbird beta
  6. Complete any sign-in steps requested
  7. Remove the beta
